description: This file contains serialization and copying logic for the ImmutableStack<T> type, including a serializer, surrogate type, and deep copier implementations.

classes.name: ImmutableStackCodec<T>
classes.description: Serializer for ImmutableStack<T> utilizing surrogate serialization.

classes.name: ImmutableStackSurrogate<T>
classes.description: Surrogate type for ImmutableStack<T> to facilitate serialization.

methods.name: ConvertFromSurrogate
methods.description: Converts surrogate data back into ImmutableStack<T> by reversing the stored values.

methods.name: ConvertToSurrogate
methods.description: Converts ImmutableStack<T> into its surrogate form by storing values in a list.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Performs a deep copy of an ImmutableStack<T> using a provided copier for elements.
